author: nrfrh_azn
title: Looking for illustrator for YA fantasy novel
content: 🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. ✨ If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too! #FantasyIllustration #BookCoverArtist #YAFantasy

author: authorjmwaldrop
title: Looking to commission sci-fi illustrator for book
content: Looking to commission a sci-fi illustrator 🎨 My vibe: pastel and neon palettes, Barbie meets Blade Runner, over-the-top futuristic fashion, and unique character moments. It's for my book GROW (Your Own Boyfriend), where a lonely scientist drunk-orders a lab-grown boyfriend. Share your work or tag someone below! NO DMs. NO AI.

author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws - Anime / manga style illustrations - Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration - Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork - Semi-realistic illustrations - and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

author: maitespena
title: Looking for character illustrators for book promo
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. (All characters adults, some non-human/demons/magic, adult novel, simple style with humor)
